run_RUN_WITH_FLAG: run gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_GTestHelpTest_TestHelpFlag: test that the help flag prints the correct help message and skips test execution
test_GTestHelpTest_TestNonHelpFlag: test that non-help flags run tests normally without printing the help message
test_testPrintsHelpWithFullFlag: test that passing --help flag prints the Google Test help message to stdout
test_testPrintsHelpWithIncorrectFlagStyl: test that incorrect flag styles like single dash or slash trigger help output
